create_model_graph_def: create a Tensorflow graph from a Caffe2 model using model_to_graph_def with SSA and gradient scope enabled
build_nets_graph_def: build a Tensorflow graph from a list of Caffe2 nets using nets_to_graph_def with custom rename function
convert_protos_graph_def: convert Caffe2 NetDef protos to a Tensorflow graph using protos_to_graph_def with simplified output
refactor_operator_graph: refactor Caffe2 operators to a Tensorflow graph with _operators_to_graph_def using SSA conversion and colon replacement
test_operator_node: test converting a Caffe2 operator to a Tensorflow graph node using _operator_to_node with shape and device attributes
